name: KvikIO reads from FSx for Lustre: compat off (must be direct) vs compat on (CPU bounce), with the host's cuFile 1.17

tasks.name: KVIKIO_COMPAT_MODE=off with cuFile strict: a successful read is a direct read (cuFile 1.20 from the KvikIO wheel refuses this file; see 50-cufile-version)
commands: [ -f /fsx/gdsio/f7 ] || { NG=$(nvidia-smi -L | wc -l); for g in $(seq 0 $((NG-1))); do [ -f /fsx/gdsio/f$g ] || dd if=/dev/urandom of=/fsx/gdsio/f$g bs=16M count=1024 oflag=direct status=none & done; wait; }

for G in 1 8; do for T in 1 4 16; do LD_PRELOAD=$CUFILE_LIB $VENV/bin/python $INVESTIGATION_DIR/scripts/kvikio_read.py --label fsx-strict --dir /fsx/gdsio --out $OUT --gpus $G --threads $T --compat off; done; done

tasks.name: KVIKIO_COMPAT_MODE=on: KvikIO reads with POSIX into pinned memory and copies
commands: for G in 1 8; do for T in 1 4 16; do LD_PRELOAD=$CUFILE_LIB $VENV/bin/python $INVESTIGATION_DIR/scripts/kvikio_read.py --label fsx-compat --dir /fsx/gdsio --out $OUT --gpus $G --threads $T --compat on; done; done
